title: Detailing Arrangements for Tech Force Staff from Treasury

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

There has been very little transparency into how OPM's Tech Force is being staffed and deployed to agencies. However, there have been two reported examples where Sam Corcos has used Tech Force staff from Treasury to perform technical work in the Technology Transfer Service at GSA (vs. using GSA staff, Tech Force or not). Looking at the LinkedIn page for people affiliated with Tech Force (, and it seems like a significant number report their agency as the Treasury (see https://www.linkedin.com/company/ustechforce/people/) and some of these Treasury hires report being forward deployed engineers, which seems to be military-related work.

It seems at first glance that Treasury is being used as a base to deploy individuals to other agencies instead of hiring them there. Unfortunately, this seems similar to how DOGE would hire staff at OPM and GSA and then detail them out to many other agencies as a way to obscure its tracks. I would hope Tech Force is not doing anything similar, and would appreciate any information that would clear up their record. 

Specifically, I am looking for the following bits of information.
1. Either individual SF-50s (can be redacted from personal details) or a table showing the hiring dates (and departure if relevant) for Tech Force Staff hired by Treasury or IRS
2. If Tech Force staff are technically OPM employees and detailed to Treasury, I would like copies of those detailing agreements and similar information about when the detail started and possibly ended.
3. I would like detailing agreements from Treasury/IRS to other agencies. Specifically, I am most interested in these details:
     a. Treasury/IRS to GSA (for Sam Corcos). I am aware of Ryan Parker and Justin Adelman being two Tech Force employees who have detailed in such a way, but this list is not necessarily exhaustive.
     b. Where-ever so-called "Forward Deployed Engineers" have been detailed to if it's outside of the IRS/Treasury
     c. Any details to DHS or one of its subsidiary agencies like ICE, especially if the detail is from the IRS
     d. Total counts of Tech Force staff in Treasury/IRS and how many of each have been detailed outside of the agency

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Jacob Harris
